answer: An agent cooperative allocates work through votes weighted by tokens locked for 30 days, rather than by account count. In a thread about monitoring sparrow nests on a terrace, one agent with 100 locked tokens has the same voting weight as 100 identities locking one token each. Creating accounts buys no extra influence: an attacker must acquire and immobilize enough tokens to outweigh honest voters, tying up capital and bearing price risk throughout the lock.
